title: Meet Idilla - The Bold New Basin Series Direct From Italy
bodyHtml:
Idilla — Where Heritage informs Modernity

Idilla is the latest development by our esteemed manufacturing partners Alice Ceramica, drawing upon Italy’s rich ceramic tradition, then reinterpreting it with boldness and restraint.

Defined by soft curves, generous walls and fine detailing, each piece in the collection has been sculpted to stand as both a functional object and a quiet work of art.

Design That Invites Closer Inspection

Hand-finished in Italy, Idilla reveals itself through layers: from afar, its silhouette is confident and architectural; up close, delicate transitions and subtle asymmetries begin to surface.

It’s a series that rewards attention — considered, balanced, and materially honest.


Idilla Oval in Gloss Myrtle - 600 x 350 x 130 mm

The Idilla Structure

Idilla reaches its full sculptural potential when paired with the Idilla Structure — a fully ceramic, hand-formed base designed to echo the geometry of the basin above.

Together, they create a seamless, monolithic presence that elevates the entire bathroom composition.

Finish, Form, Freedom

Available in a refined palette of matte and gloss finishes, Idilla allows for expressive coordination across a wide range of design languages — from serene minimalism to richer, more emotive spaces.

With full ceramic construction and generous internal proportions, the basins are as versatile and practical as they are sculptural.

Trends defined, not followed

Idilla is not designed to follow trends, but to outlast them — a refined response to contemporary bathroom design that places equal value on form, function and feeling.
